title: First Images from EO-1 Satellite
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: NASA's contemporaneous report confirms ALI acquired and returned images of Alaska. It describes the displayed panchromatic comparison with Landsat 7 and the finer pixel size of that ALI band. The dates in the migrated paragraph are poorly typeset, so the exact ALI acquisition day is based on the instrument developer's account.

file.method: Selected, claim-specific paraphrases and short excerpts from the cited passages.
